ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets appeal to my interest in melodic, polished singing, as reflected in Stages and Lead With Your Heart.
ItemID: NA; Title: 2015 GRAMMY Nominees; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad compilation feels less focused on the vocal and relaxing music I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: From A Room: Volume 2; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in orchestral or vocal crossover music this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It connects with my Christmas listening, but I would save it for a seasonal mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Cheers to the Fall; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It is less directly connected to the classical and theatrical vocal music I currently want.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Pentatonix Christmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal Christmas focus interests me, but I am not choosing holiday music today.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Expressive singing and melodic ballads would fit my interest in emotionally engaging vocal albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hell's Radio the Legendary Broadcasts 1974-1979 Box; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An archival broadcast box is not compelling enough for my current preference for a focused, relaxing album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Home for Christmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My history includes Christmas music, but I would leave this for another listening occasion.
ItemID: NA; Title: Advent At Ephesus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The contemplative sacred music appeals to my relaxing listening mood, but the Advent theme makes it a choice for later.
